newsitem.title: USA: Thermwood sees record FY97 sales, net.
newsitem.headline: Thermwood sees record FY97 sales, net.

text.p: Thermwood Corp said Monday it expects record sales and earnings for fiscal 1997.

"We anticipate that our consistent sales growth over the past six quarters and record order backlog will continue into the fourth quarter and result in a record performance in sales and earnings for fiscal 1997," Kenneth Susnjara, president, said in a statement.
Earlier, Thermwood reported earnings for the third quarter ended April 30 were $253,594 or $0.03 a share, compared with year-ago earnings of $292,930 or $0.03 a year ago.
The 1997 third quarter results included income taxes of $157,847 compared with $9,000 in taxes a year ago.
"The real indicator of our performance continues to be our growth in operating profit," Susnjara said. Operating profit for the third quarter rose to $426,536 from $347,560 a year ago.

Thermwood said backlog increased in the third quarter to an all-time company high of $3,800,000, compared to $2,500,00 at the end of the preceding quarter and $1,400,000 for the same period a year ago.
